How Example Widgets Inc. decides where to spend on ads

Return on ad spend (ROAS) drives the budget, and paid search wins most quarters.

Generated 27 Sep 2026 · 3 sources

In depth

Why ad spend is judged by ROAS

Example Widgets Inc. judges every channel by ROAS, the revenue earned for each dollar spent. A channel with a ROAS of 4 returns four dollars for every dollar. See the pricing page.

  • Paid search: intent is high, so conversion is strong
  • Social: cheap reach, weaker conversion
  • Email: tiny cost, utm tagged

Key point

A ROAS below 1 means the channel loses money before any other cost.

2. How the budget moved

Budget shifted toward search over the year, while display was cut. ROAS stayed the north star.

How an order flows

From click to delivery

  1. Click

    A shopper clicks a search ad.

  2. Buy

    They buy a widget; revenue is attributed to search.

  3. Ship

    The warehouse ships within two days.

  1. Only: A stepper with one step becomes a list.

Think of it like

ROAS is like a vending machine that tells you how many snacks each coin buys.
